entries.en: Naomi is a rookie mail-rider who graduated#nfrom Arzenal’s junior division and was assigned#nto the First Company. Coco and Miranda#nwere in her class in the junior division.#nCertain circumstances left her saddled#nwith an enormous debt, and she races around#nArzenal day and night#nto repay it. She believes that comrades must#nwork together to survive,#nand strives to improve relations#nwithin the First Company,#neven when that means clashing with others.
